points.title: 童年与部落生活
points.description: 成吉思汗原名铁木真，出生于蒙古乞颜部贵族家庭。父亲也速该是部落首领，在他9岁时被塔塔儿人毒杀。铁木真随后被部落抛弃，与家人在草原上艰难求生。这段经历培养了他坚韧不拔的性格和对部落忠诚的深刻理解。1171年，他被泰赤乌部俘虏，后成功逃脱。这段苦难童年使铁木真深刻体会到权力与生存的重要性，为他日后统一蒙古各部奠定了思想基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born as Temüjin to a noble family of the Khamag Mongol tribe, his father Yesügei was poisoned by Tatars when he was nine. Abandoned by his tribe, Temüjin and his family endured extreme hardship on the steppe, which forged his resilience and understanding of tribal loyalty. In 1171, he was captured by the Taijitu tribe but escaped. This difficult childhood instilled in him a profound understanding of power and survival, laying the foundation for his later unification of Mongol tribes.

points.title: 统一蒙古各部
points.description: 1189年，铁木真被推举为乞颜部可汗，开始了他统一蒙古各部的征程。他先后击败了主儿乞部、泰赤乌部、克烈部、乃蛮部等强大部落。1203年，他在合兰真沙陀之战中击败克烈部王罕；1204年，征服乃蛮部太阳汗。铁木真运用军事才能和政治智慧，通过联姻、结盟和征服等手段，逐步将蒙古高原上分散的部落统一。他建立了严格的军事制度，推行千户制，并制定了《大札撒》法律，为蒙古帝国的建立奠定了制度基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1189, Temüjin was proclaimed Khan of the Khamag Mongol tribe, beginning his quest to unify Mongol tribes. He successively defeated powerful tribes including the Jurkin, Taijitu, Keraite, and Naiman. In 1203, he defeated Wang Khan of the Keraite at the Battle of Khalkhin Gol; in 1204, he conquered Naiman leader Tayang Khan. Temüjin employed military prowess and political wisdom, using marriage, alliances, and conquest to gradually unify the scattered tribes on the Mongolian Plateau. He established a strict military system, implemented the decimal organization, and created the Great Yassa legal code, laying the institutional foundation for the Mongol Empire.

points.title: 建立蒙古帝国
points.description: 1206年，铁木真在斡难河源头召开忽里勒台（部落大会），被各部落一致推举为大汗，尊号成吉思汗，意为拥有四海的大汗。他正式建立了蒙古帝国，推行千户制、怯薛军（禁卫军）制度，并颁布《大札撒》作为帝国法律。这一时期，成吉思汗开始对外扩张，先后征服了西夏和金朝的部分领土。1211年，他发动对金朝的大规模进攻，1215年攻占金中都（今北京），使蒙古帝国成为东亚地区最强大的政权。
points.descriptionEn: In 1206, Temüjin convened a kurultai (tribal assembly) at the source of the Onon River, where he was unanimously proclaimed as the Great Khan with the title Genghis Khan, meaning 'universal ruler.' He formally established the Mongol Empire, implementing the decimal organization system, the Keshig (imperial guard), and issuing the Great Yassa as the empire's legal code. During this period, Genghis Khan began external expansion, conquering parts of Western Xia and the Jin Dynasty. In 1211, he launched a massive invasion of the Jin Dynasty, capturing Zhongdu (modern Beijing) in 1215, making the Mongol Empire the most powerful state in East Asia.

points.title: 西征花剌子模
points.description: 1219年，成吉思汗以花剌子模杀害蒙古商队和使者为由，发动了对中亚花剌子模帝国的远征。他率领蒙古大军，采取分进合击、迂回包抄的战术，先后攻占了布哈拉、撒马尔罕等城市。1221年，蒙古军队攻陷花剌子模首都玉龙杰赤，花剌子模沙摩诃末逃亡后病死。这次西征不仅使蒙古帝国版图扩展到中亚，还打通了东西方贸易通道，促进了东西方文化交流。成吉思汗在这次战役中展示了卓越的军事才能和战略眼光，为后来的蒙古西征奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1219, citing the killing of Mongol merchants and envoys, Genghis Khan launched a western campaign against the Khwarezm Empire in Central Asia. Leading his army, he employed tactics of multiple pronged attacks and flanking maneuvers, successively capturing cities including Bukhara and Samarkand. In 1221, Mongol forces conquered Khwarezm's capital Urgench, and Sultan Muhammad II fled and died shortly after. This western expansion not only extended the Mongol Empire's territory to Central Asia but also opened trade routes between East and West, promoting cultural exchange. Genghis Khan demonstrated exceptional military talent and strategic vision during this campaign, laying the foundation for subsequent Mongol western expeditions.

points.title: 晚年征西夏
points.description: 1226年，成吉思汗亲率大军征讨西夏，这是他生命中最后一次大规模军事行动。蒙古军队迅速攻占了西夏重镇银川、灵武等地。1227年，西夏末帝投降，西夏灭亡。然而，在征讨西夏期间，成吉思汗在六盘山地区病逝，享年65岁。关于他的死因，有坠马、疾病等多种说法。成吉思汗去世后，被安葬在不斡儿罕山（今肯特山）的神秘地点。他的去世标志着一个时代的结束，但蒙古帝国在他子孙的继续扩张下，最终成为历史上版图最广阔的帝国。
points.descriptionEn: In 1226, Genghis Khan personally led a campaign against Western Xia, his last major military operation. Mongol forces quickly captured key Western Xia cities including Yinchuan and Lingwu. In 1227, the last Western Xia emperor surrendered, leading to the dynasty's fall. However, during this campaign, Genghis Khan fell ill and died in the Liupan Mountain region at age 65. The cause of his death remains debated, with theories including falling from a horse and illness. After his death, he was buried in a secret location in the Burkhan Khaldun Mountains (modern-day Khentii Mountains). His death marked the end of an era, but under his successors, the Mongol Empire would eventually become the largest contiguous land empire in history.

supporter.zh: 成吉思汗被视为蒙古民族的伟大统一者和民族英雄。他结束了蒙古高原长期的部落纷争，建立了强大的蒙古帝国，为蒙古民族的发展奠定了基础。他推行的军事制度、法律体系和行政管理模式具有开创性，促进了蒙古社会的进步。同时，他打通了东西方贸易通道，促进了不同文明间的交流与融合，对世界历史进程产生了深远影响。成吉思汗的领导才能、军事智慧和坚韧不拔的精神，至今仍被蒙古人民所敬仰和传承。
supporter.en: Genghis Khan is revered as the great unifier and national hero of the Mongol people. He ended the long-standing tribal conflicts on the Mongolian Plateau and established the powerful Mongol Empire, laying the foundation for Mongol national development. The military system, legal code, and administrative model he introduced were pioneering, promoting social progress in Mongolia. Meanwhile, he opened trade routes between East and West, facilitating cultural exchange between different civilizations, profoundly influencing world history. Genghis Khan's leadership, military wisdom, and indomitable spirit continue to be admired and passed down by the Mongol people.

critic.zh: 批评者认为成吉思汗的征服战争造成了巨大的人员伤亡和文化破坏。他的军队在征服过程中实施了大规模屠杀，如花剌子模战役中多个城市被夷为平地，无数平民死亡。此外，蒙古西征导致了多个文明的衰落，如中亚、西亚地区的文化发展受到严重阻碍。成吉思汗建立的帝国虽然强大，但统治手段残酷，对被征服民族实行高压政策，缺乏对当地文化的尊重和保护。这些行为使他在许多历史学家和被征服民族眼中被视为残暴的征服者而非伟大的统治者。
critic.en: Critics argue that Genghis Khan's conquest campaigns caused massive casualties and cultural destruction. His armies carried out large-scale massacres during conquests, such as the complete destruction of several cities during the Khwarezm campaign where countless civilians perished. Additionally, the Mongol western expeditions led to the decline of multiple civilizations, severely hindering cultural development in Central and West Asia. Although the empire he established was powerful, his rule was brutal, implementing high-handed policies against conquered peoples and lacking respect for local cultures. These actions have led many historians and conquered peoples to view him as a brutal conqueror rather than a great ruler.

objective.zh: 从客观历史视角看，成吉思汗是历史上最具影响力的军事领袖和帝国建设者之一。他的征服战争虽然造成了巨大破坏，但也客观上促进了欧亚大陆的交流与融合，建立了历史上版图最广阔的连续性帝国。在军事史上，他创新的战术和组织方式对后世军事发展产生了深远影响。在文化层面，蒙古帝国时期的东西方交流促进了技术、思想和商品的传播，如中国的火药、印刷术和伊斯兰世界的科学知识通过蒙古统治下的丝绸之路得以广泛传播。现代历史学界倾向于将成吉思汗置于更广阔的世界历史背景下评价，既承认其军事成就，也不忽视其征服带来的破坏性影响。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Genghis Khan stands as one of the most influential military leaders and empire builders in history. While his conquest campaigns caused massive destruction, they objectively promoted communication and integration across Eurasia, establishing the largest contiguous empire in history. In military history, his innovative tactics and organizational approaches had profound impacts on subsequent military development. Culturally, the exchanges between East and West during the Mongol Empire facilitated the spread of technology, ideas, and goods—such as Chinese gunpowder, printing, and Islamic scientific knowledge—which spread widely along the Silk Road under Mongol rule. Modern historiography tends to evaluate Genghis Khan within the broader context of world history, acknowledging both his military achievements and the destructive impacts of his conquests.

self.zh: 我最大的快乐就是征服敌人，追击他们，夺取他们的财产，让他们所爱的人流泪，骑他们的马，拥抱他们的妻子和女儿。
self.en: The greatest happiness is to vanquish your enemies, to chase them, to rob them of their wealth, to see those dear to them bathed in tears, to ride their horses, and to embrace their wives and daughters.

others.zh: 成吉思汗是历史上最伟大的军事天才，他创建的帝国和制度对世界历史产生了深远影响。
others.en: Genghis Khan was the greatest military genius in history, and the empire and systems he created had a profound impact on world history.
